KMT, TPP legislators reject all 27 of Lai's Control Yuan nominees
summary: Taipei, Sept. 29 (CNA) The opposition-controlled Legislative Yuan on Tuesday voted down all 27 of President Lai Ching-te's (賴清德) nominees for the Control Yuan, Taiwan's government watchdog body.

title: KMT proposes NT$20,000 universal cash handout
summary: Taipei, Sept. 29 (CNA) Taiwan's main opposition Kuomintang (KMT) on Tuesday proposed using surplus tax revenues to fund a universal NT$20,000 (US$627.31) cash handout, double the amount proposed last month by President Lai Ching-te (賴清德).

title: Morocco resumes Taiwanese tourism visa applications: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Sept. 28 (CNA)The Taiwan government said Monday it had received confirmation Morocco resumed accepting tourism visa applications from Taiwanese passport holders last week, two months after abruptly suspending the process in July.

title: DPP at 40: Founders reflect on risk, rise, reckoning
summary: Taipei, Sept. 28 (CNA) Four decades after the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) was founded under martial law, its pioneers recall the risks they took, the democratic changes they helped bring about and the challenges facing the party today.
